name: Fog Volume Grid Rendering
aliases: Fog Volume Grid Rendering — FogMaterial volumetric fog integration, FogVolume Volumetric Rendering
definition: A technique to draw FogVolume and FogMaterial nodes into the volumetric fog by adding their density, albedo, and emission to the froxels (volumetric grid cells) that the volume's shape covers, matching Godot 4.6.3's behavior.
summary: Fog Volume Grid Rendering accumulates local volumetric fog properties into a froxel grid to create non-uniform effects like fog banks that global settings cannot achieve.
